headline.zh: 临街落地窗+室外遮阳伞座位
headline.en: Street-facing floor-to-ceiling windows + shaded outdoor seats

traits.zh: 整面临街玻璃，白天可见二楼开放式阳台
traits.en: Floor-to-ceiling street-facing windows; open balcony visible on second floor during daytime

traits.zh: 室外设4-6个座位，配白色遮阳伞
traits.en: 4–6 outdoor seats with white sun umbrellas

traits.zh: 夜间店内灯光明亮，透过窗户可见内部陈设
traits.en: Bright interior lighting at night, visible through windows

traits.zh: 高德推荐单人餐、双人餐
traits.en: Single and double set meals recommended on Gaode

traits.zh: 周六营业至24:00，周日至周三22:00关门
traits.en: Open until 24:00 on Saturdays; closes at 22:00 Sundays–Wednesdays

linger.zh: 有室外座位且室内舒适可久坐

energy.zh: 临街有人行横道和信号灯
energy.en: Street location with crosswalk and traffic light
